description: Sixteen voltmeters, each drawing the voltage at its input as a bar, with the signal passed on unchanged. The full scale is 1V, 10V or 100V, chosen in the menu

inputs.text: The voltage that row measures; a polyphonic cable into the first row is spread across all sixteen rows, and a cable in any single row overrides the channel it would have taken

outputs.text: A copy of the voltage at that row's input, so the meter can be dropped into the middle of a patch; the first row can carry all sixteen rows out as one polyphonic cable

menu: 1 Volt Scale — a full bar stands for 1V, with 10 Volts Scale and 100 Volts Scale beside it
UNIPOLAR MODE — reads only positive voltages, ignoring anything below 0V
USE ABSOLUTE VALUES — multiplies negative voltages by -1, so they read as positive
